countedBy: lane (opus) from the rectified crops, 2026-11-07, before comparing with the model; each framed light of the serre is one opening (its single mullion does not split it), each slit one opening. Blind recount welcome.

facades.name: Serre south front (w04)
facades.note: Six bays of deep dark frames: the 4.8 m ground storey (the revolving door in the fifth bay from the west) and six storeys over it.

facades.name: West wing south end (w05)
facades.note: Sandstone with scattered slits, bottom row first: 4, 4, 3, 4, 3, 5.

facades.name: East wing south end (w06)
facades.note: The same sandstone, bleached by the low sun in this view, with five rows of slits (bottom first 4, 4, 3, 4, 5) over the recessed ribbed green-glass ground storey (not counted).
